N'elu ala dị larịị na-enweghị esemokwu, ike kwụ ọtọ $F = 10\text{ N}$ na-arụ ọrụ n'ihe dị arọ $m = 2\text{ kg}$ n'ebe dị anya nke $4\text{ m}$. Nkwupụta dị aṅaa na-akọwa ọrụ $W$ na ngwangwa $a$ n'ụzọ ziri ezi?

Nkwupụta dị aṅaa na-akọwa ọrụ $W$ na ngwangwa $a$ n'ụzọ ziri ezi?

20261121-physics-g09-1.title: Mmegharị na ume mechanical
20261121-physics-g09-1.goal: Tinye ụkpụrụ nke Mmegharị na ume mechanical iji dozie nsogbu nnyocha.
20261121-physics-g09-1.material: [M3 Nnyocha Fiziks (Dị Elu)] Nyocha mmegharị ọdịda n'efu metụtara Mmegharị na ume mechanical. A tụpụrụ otu ihe site na izu ike na mbara na-enweghị ikuku n'okpuru ike ndọda $g = 9.8\text{ m/s}^2$. Gịnị bụ ọsọ $v$ na anya $h$ mgbe $t = 3\text{ s}$ gachara?
20261121-physics-g09-1.s.s1.prompt: [M3 Nnyocha Fiziks (Dị Elu)] Nyocha mmegharị ọdịda n'efu metụtara Mmegharị na ume mechanical. A tụpụrụ otu ihe site na izu ike na mbara na-enweghị ikuku n'okpuru ike ndọda $g = 9.8\text{ m/s}^2$. Gịnị bụ ọsọ $v$ na anya $h$ mgbe $t = 3\text{ s}$ gachara?
20261121-physics-g09-1.s.s1.explain:
Nzọụkwụ 1: Ọsọ $v = gt = 9.8 \times 3 = 29.4\text{ m/s}$.
Nzọụkwụ 2: Anya $h = \frac{1}{2}gt^2 = 0.5 \times 9.8 \times 9 = 44.1\text{ m}$.
Nzọụkwụ 3: Ya mere $v = 29.4\text{ m/s}$ na $h = 44.1\text{ m}$.

20261121-physics-g10-1.s.s1.prompt: [H1 Nnyocha Fiziks (Dị Elu)] Nyocha mmegharị ọdịda n'efu metụtara Sistemụ mechanical. A tụpụrụ otu ihe site na izu ike na mbara na-enweghị ikuku n'okpuru ike ndọda $g = 9.8\text{ m/s}^2$. Gịnị bụ ọsọ $v$ na anya $h$ mgbe $t = 3\text{ s}$ gachara?

Nzọụkwụ 1: Ọsọ $v = gt = 9.8 \times 3 = 29.4\text{ m/s}$.
Nzọụkwụ 2: Anya $h = \frac{1}{2}gt^2 = 0.5 \times 9.8 \times 9 = 44.1\text{ m}$.
Nzọụkwụ 3: Ya mere $v = 29.4\text{ m/s}$ na $h = 44.1\text{ m}$.
